datasets.name: Mexico City adjusted cumulative line-of-sight displacement
datasets.product: OPERA L3 DISP-S1 V1, Sentinel-1 ascending, frame 20688, VV
datasets.spatial_resolution: 30 m source product; compact time-series sample points
datasets.units: cm LOS relative to estimated stable ground
datasets.license: Product-specific redistribution terms are not recorded in the supplied export; verify with NASA ASF DAAC.
datasets.processing: Displayed pack. A uniform 5.75 cm/yr scene-most-common LOS offset was removed from every pixel; cumulative values were adjusted by elapsed time. Headline rate is calculated from the most-subsiding 1% of the compact sample points.
assumptions_and_caveats: Assumes most of the area is stable ground and the offset is uniform; neither is proven.
LOS is not vertical displacement and is relative to estimated stable ground, not an absolute frame.
Atmospheric correction is incomplete and chained blocks may accumulate error.
The compact point sample is approximate and is not a full-scene pixel statistic.

findings.public_statement: For the adjusted sampled area (2022-03-27 to 2026-02-16), the 2nd-percentile LOS velocity is -20.84 cm/year. This is a sample-based distribution indicator, not the rate at every location.
findings.research_statement: OPERA L3 DISP-S1 adjusted sample summary: p2=-20.84, median=-0.05, p98=1.20 cm/year LOS. Source: OPERA L3 DISP-S1 V1 (NASA/JPL), Sentinel-1 ascending, frame 20688, VV, 30 m.
limitations: Compact sampled statistic, not a full-scene pixel calculation.
findings.uncertainty: Relative to estimated stable ground; atmospheric correction is incomplete.

findings.public_statement: The adjusted product summary reports 29.5% of valid pixels faster than 3 cm/year LOS and 15.2% faster than 10 cm/year LOS.
findings.research_statement: Percent shares are from the supplied adjusted summary and use its valid-pixel mask.
limitations: These fractions describe the valid mask and are not exposure or damage estimates.
findings.uncertainty: Depends on the adjusted reference and common-valid-pixel mask.

findings.public_statement: The displayed values are relative to estimated stable ground. The adjustment assumes most of the scene is stable and a uniform offset applies everywhere; this is not proven.
findings.research_statement: The adjusted pack subtracted 5.75 cm/year scene-most-common LOS velocity. The stated assumption is: most pixels in the area are stable ground and the offset is uniform over the area.
findings.uncertainty: The stable-ground and uniform-offset assumptions are not independently established.

findings.public_statement: Two quiet GNSS stations were used only for an independent adjustment check; the available comparison covers 3 stations. It is approximate because GNSS is vertical and InSAR is line of sight.
findings.research_statement: GNSS was not used to set the offset. Station coverage and measurement directions differ; interpret as a limited consistency check, not validation.
limitations: Few stations and uneven period coverage.
Vertical GNSS and LOS InSAR are not equivalent measurements.
findings.uncertainty: Approximate independent check; not validation of the adjustment.

findings.public_statement: Groundwater extraction is discussed in published research as a possible contributor to ground compaction; this app has no groundwater observations to test that explanation.
findings.research_statement: No groundwater-level, pumping, or well dataset is registered for this region. Literature context is not a project measurement.
findings.uncertainty: Possible explanation only; no local groundwater evidence is available in this project.

findings.public_statement: No Assam satellite observations have been added.
findings.research_statement: Flood inundation, river migration, erosion and deposition are separate planned analyses; no regional measurement is available.

findings.public_statement: No Pine Island Glacier observations have been added.
findings.research_statement: Ice velocity, shelf extent, elevation and mass balance remain distinct planned measurements; none is available here.
